name: Anna - Ensnared Sister
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
zh: 迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）

name: Bruno Madrigal - Unspeakable Seer
en:
DARK PROPHECY When you play this character, each
opposing player puts the top 3 cards of their deck into
their discard.
zh: 黑暗預言　當你打出這個角色時，每位對手將其牌庫頂的 3 張牌放入棄牌堆。

name: Flotsam - Wicked Defender
en:
Bodyguard (An opposing character who challenges one of
your characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
URSULA'S SENTRY This character enters play exerted.
zh:
護衛（挑戰你角色的對方角色，若有能力必須選擇具護衛的角色。）
Ursula 的哨兵　這個角色以橫置狀態進場。

name: Gaston - Egotistical Bully
en:
POSITIVELY PRIMEVAL When you play this
character, deal 4 damage to the opposing
character with the lowest cost. (If there's a tie, the
opposing players choose from the tied characters.)
zh: 十足原始　當你打出這個角色時，對費用最低的對方角色造成 4 點傷害。（若有平手，由對手從平手的角色中選擇。）

name: HeiHei - Peckish Pal
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
zh: 迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）

name: Hercules - Manipulated Hero
en:
Bodyguard (An opposing character who challenges one of
your characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
URSULA'S SENTRY This character enters play exerted.
EVERYTHING HAS A PRICE During the opposing players'
turn, they may together pay 3 lore to banish this character.
zh:
護衛（挑戰你角色的對方角色，若有能力必須選擇具護衛的角色。）
Ursula 的哨兵　這個角色以橫置狀態進場。
凡事皆有代價　在對手的回合中，他們可以一起支付 3 點傳說值來消滅這個角色。

name: Jetsam - Wicked Whisperer
en:
URSULA HAS GREAT POWERS When you play this
character, deal 1 damage to each opposing character.
zh: Ursula 擁有強大力量　當你打出這個角色時，對每個對方角色造成 1 點傷害。

name: Minnie Mouse - Wild-Eyed Diver
en:
CONFUSING PRESENCE When you play this
character, each opposing player loses 2 lore.
zh: 令人困惑的存在　當你打出這個角色時，每位對手失去 2 點傳說值。

name: Prince Eric - Grim Groom
en:
Bodyguard (An opposing character who challenges one
of your characters must choose one with Bodyguard if
able.)
URSULA'S SENTRY This character enters play exerted.
zh:
護衛（挑戰你角色的對方角色，若有能力必須選擇具護衛的角色。）
Ursula 的哨兵　這個角色以橫置狀態進場。

name: Shark - Toothy Terror
en:
BIG BULLY When you play this character, deal 2
damage to each opposing damaged character.
zh: 大惡霸　當你打出這個角色時，對每個受傷的對方角色造成 2 點傷害。

name: Tamatoa - Grabby Crab
en:
PICK ONE! When you play this character, the
opposing players together choose an item or
location of theirs and banish it.
zh: 選一個！　當你打出這個角色時，對手一起選擇他們的一個物品或地點並消滅它。

name: Capsize
en:
If you have 6 ⬡ or less, put the top 3 cards of your
deck into your inkwell facedown.
If you have 7 ⬡ or more, each opposing player chooses
and banishes one of their characters.
zh:
若你有 6 ⬡ 或以下，將你牌庫頂的 3 張牌牌面朝下放入你的墨水池。
若你有 7 ⬡ 或以上，每位對手選擇並消滅他們的一個角色。

name: Choppy Waters
en:
Deal 2 damage to the highest cost character each
opposing player has in play. (If there's a tie, the
opposing player chooses from the tied characters.)
zh: 對每位對手在場費用最高的角色造成 2 點傷害。（若有平手，由該對手從平手的角色中選擇。）

name: Crushing Wave
en: Deal 2 damage to each opposing character.
zh: 對每個對方角色造成 2 點傷害。

name: Entangling Magic
en:
Each opposing player discards a card. Then, put this card into
your inkwell facedown.
zh: 每位對手棄掉一張牌。然後，將這張牌牌面朝下放入你的墨水池。

name: Fortunate Hit
en:
The opposing players together choose one of your
items and banish it.
zh: 對手一起選擇你的一個物品並消滅它。

name: Lash Out
en:
Each opposing player chooses and banishes one of
their characters.
zh: 每位對手選擇並消滅他們的一個角色。

name: Lightning Storm
en: Each opposing player loses 3 lore.
zh: 每位對手失去 3 點傳說值。

name: Riptide
en:
Banish all opposing characters, items, and locations
with cost 2 or less.
zh: 消滅所有費用 2 或以下的對方角色、物品和地點。

name: Tentacle Swipe
en:
Deal 1 damage to each opposing character. Then, put
this card into your inkwell facedown.
zh: 對每個對方角色造成 1 點傷害。然後，將這張牌牌面朝下放入你的墨水池。

name: Tsunami
en: Banish all opposing characters.
zh: 消滅所有對方角色。

name: Typhoon
en:
Return all opposing exerted characters to their players'
hands.
zh: 將所有橫置的對方角色返回其持有者的手牌。

name: Whirlpool
en:
Exert all opposing characters. They can't ready at the
start of the their next turn.
zh: 橫置所有對方角色。他們在其下個回合開始時不能準備。

name: The Hexwell Crown
en: PERKS OF POWER ⟳ — Draw a card.
zh: 權力的好處　⟳ — 抽一張牌。

name: Ursula's Contract
en:
SWEETEN THE DEAL Opposing players can't use
battleground abilities.
MINOR STIPULATION At the start of your turn, banish
this item to gain 3 lore.
zh:
讓交易更甜美　對手不能使用戰場能力。
次要條款　在你的回合開始時，消滅這個物品來獲得 3 點傳說值。

name: Ursula's Stolen Trident
en: IT'S MY POWER NOW ⟳ — Gain 1 lore.
zh: 現在這是我的力量了　⟳ — 獲得 1 點傳說值。
